headline: On November 8, 2016: Modi announces ₹500 and ₹1000 note withdrawal
captionCards: 86% of cash withdrawn in one day
Spurred nationwide shift to digital transactions
instagramCaption:
India’s cash system flipped overnight.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the demonetisation of ₹500 and ₹1,000 banknotes on November 8, 2016. The move targeted the shadow economy and counterfeit currency. New ₹500 and ₹2,000 notes were introduced to replace them. Over 86% of cash in circulation was withdrawn in a single day.

It accelerated India’s shift toward digital payments and reshaped financial habits nationwide.
